message.reasoning:
need to fix compilation errors. The test uses JUnit 4 imports (org.junit.*) and static org.junit.Assert.* which have assertEquals(Object expected, Object actual) without message parameter (message is first param). In JUnit 4, overload with message is assertEquals(String message, Object expected, Object actual). The code currently uses assertEquals(expected, actual, "msg") which is JUnit5 style. So we need to reorder parameters.

Also annotations @BeforeAll, @BeforeEach, @Test are JUnit5. In JUnit4 they are @BeforeClass, @Before, @Test (from org.junit). So we should replace @BeforeAll with @BeforeClass static method, @BeforeEach with @Before, and remove ExtendWith and MockitoExtension imports (not needed). Also remove those imports.

Also need to import org.junit.BeforeClass, org.junit.Before.

Also need to adjust assertNull, assertNotNull, assertSame signatures: JUnit4 has assertNull(Object) and assertNull(String message, Object). The code uses assertNull(obj, "msg") which is JUnit4 style? Actually JUnit4's assertNull(String message, Object object). So order is message first. The code uses assertNull(emptyPosition.getExit(), "msg") which is reversed. So need to swap.

Similarly assertNotNull, assertSame have message first.

Also assertEquals with message first.

So modify all assertions.

Also need to import necessary JUnit classes.

Remove MockitoExtension and ExtendWith.

Now check other compile errors: Trade.sellAt(1, DoubleNum.valueOf(Double.NaN), DoubleNum.valueOf(Double.NaN)) - maybe there is a method signature for sellAt without cost model? In earlier they used Trade.sellAt(index, price, amount) without cost model; that exists maybe. Keep.

Also need to ensure Position constructors used exist. Position() default, Position(Trade entry, Trade exit, CostModel transaction, CostModel holding) exists. Position(Trade.TradeType, CostModel, CostModel) exists.

Now adjust imports: remove org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension and org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith.

Add org.junit.BeforeClass, org.junit.Before.

Now fix annotation usage.

Let's rewrite code.
